# Nickelite 1.1.1

Corrects the vertical spacing between the two Menu items button rows to 6 px and replaces the three Settings screenshots with verified 1.1.1 simulator captures. This patch retains the KOReader shortcut introduced in 1.1.0.

The 6.0.279225 userspace simulator showed the corrected Shortcuts, Menu items, and Permissions views. Both pinned firmware packages passed ARM compatibility and archive checksum checks. The physical Clara BW layout still needs a device check.

Download the ZIP matching your exact firmware version and follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/open-source-arena/Nickelite#download-and-install). Existing `.adds/nm` configuration is preserved.
